checks.explanation: The predicted 5-year window (through roughly 2030) hasn't elapsed.

Only about a year has passed of the predicted 5-year window; the physical AI chip market remains far smaller than the data center chip market so far, consistent with (but not yet proving) the prediction.

The AI accelerator market has already likely exceeded $500B within about a year: Nvidia's data center segment alone generated roughly $75.2B in a single quarter (an approximately $300B annualized pace) by mid-2026, before adding AMD, Broadcom, and other accelerator vendors.
The predicted 4-year window (through roughly 2029) has barely begun.
